enumeration_note: One anchored-VWAP-to-heavy-volume-rotation pullback skeleton taught bidirectionally (short to VWAP resistance / long to VWAP support are the same fair-price pullback logic in different contexts, not opposition). Exit is only gestural (patience/holding), so the taught setup is kept with null exit levels per Rule 1.

coaching_notes: I learned to be patient. I wait, and that's what's been working for me.
I don't really have problems holding trades, even, you know, for a couple of hours like this.
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: identify a rotation zone where heavy volume was traded using Volume Profile
PRECONDITION: the heavy-volume rotation must be followed by strong trend activity (a strong sell-off / trend leg)
Anchor the VWAP to the last candle of the rotation (= the first candle of the sell-off/trend, e.g. the huge red candle)
Entry trigger: wait for price to move away from the anchored VWAP, then enter on a pullback back to the VWAP (fair price)
Directional rule: short pullbacks to VWAP when it is resistance in a downtrend; long pullbacks when price is above VWAP and it acts as support
FILTER: do not trade while the market is rotating ('when the market is rotating, VWAP setups don't really work')
OCCURRENCE-SELECTION: take repeated pullback entries on subsequent tests of the VWAP (2nd/3rd test = another entry)
Anchor-candle tolerance: anchoring to an adjacent candle instead of the exact one barely changes the VWAP (setup not sensitive to exact anchor choice)
strategies.entry_summary: Use Volume Profile to find a rotation zone where heavy volume was traded, that must be followed by a strong trend (sell-off or trend leg). Anchor VWAP to the last candle of the rotation (= first candle of the trend). Wait for price to move away from the anchored VWAP, then enter on a pullback back to the VWAP as 'fair price' â€” short when VWAP acts as resistance in a downtrend, long when price is above VWAP and it acts as support. Re-enter on subsequent (2nd/3rd) tests of the VWAP.
strategies.exit_summary: No concrete exit/stop/target taught; speaker only notes he holds trades patiently, sometimes for a couple of hours.
strategies.name: anchored_vwap_volume_profile_pullback

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: price moves away from VWAP then pulls back up to it while VWAP is resistance in a downtrend
variants.transcript_quote: you anchor the VWAP there to this candle and then you trade pullbacks. You simply need to see the price go away from the VWAP and then enter a pullback. Here, that's short from this place.
variants.variant_label: Short pullback to anchored VWAP resistance (downtrend)

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: resistance VWAP turns into support once price moves above it; wait for pullback to that support
variants.transcript_quote: this resistance, the resistance which is represented by the VWAP, turns into a support... So, that's why you want to wait for the pullbacks to that support and enter longs from there
variants.variant_label: Long pullback to anchored VWAP support (price above VWAP)
